title: Rebuild query metadata from committed S3 canonical state
description:
As an operator, I want to rebuild the DynamoDB catalog from S3 so query metadata is recoverable independently of canonical records.

Feature: Rebuildable cloud catalog
  Scenario: Recover catalog contents
    Given normal canonical issue and event files and missing or stale catalog entries
    When an authorized scoped catalog rebuild runs
    Then it verifies payload hashes and restores query metadata and pointers from the current canonical files
    And ordinary generic queries converge to the same records
  Scenario: Exclude recovery internals
    Given auxiliary recovery journal records outside the canonical prefix
    When the canonical prefix is exported or the catalog is rebuilt
    Then recovery internals do not become canonical issues or history
  Scenario: Protect tenant boundaries during recovery
    Given canonical content for multiple tenants
    When an operator rebuilds one authorized project
    Then no other tenant's metadata or canonical files are modified
  Scenario: Repeat recovery
    Given an already repaired catalog
    When rebuild is repeated
    Then it creates no duplicate records and does not modify canonical payloads
